show.tagline: Eternity is run like an office.

episodes.title: The Queue
episodes.logline: Newly-dead Lwazi must survive Heaven's infinite processing line — and a black-market scheme to skip it.
episodes.synopsis: Lwazi 'Lucky' Nkosi dies on an ordinary Tuesday and arrives at Heaven's reception to find eternity is run like Home Affairs. Armed with ticket 047, he gets tangled in a black-market scheme to skip The Queue — only to learn the fast-track leads somewhere worse: the Complaints Department.

skits.title: Now Serving: 047
skits.setup: Lwazi arrives; the queue is infinite; the board has read 046 for 400 years.
skits.action: He meets Sven, a Viking who has queued since 862 AD and loves it; Candice hands him the E-1, the form to request the form.
skits.payoff: A shadowy figure offers the Fast-Track.

skits.title: The Fast-Track
skits.setup: Nigel pitches a golden Fast-Track Pass traded through a favour economy.
skits.action: A Snatch-style caper: steal Sven's helmet for the Sultan to move the pass down the line.
skits.payoff: The pass drops on the floor; thunder cracks at the mention of Brenda.

skits.title: Processing Error
skits.setup: Brenda reveals the Fast-Track was a Renaissance pilot programme issued to everyone.
skits.action: The pass fast-tracks you straight to the Complaints Department (Moses).
skits.payoff: Lwazi's 047 is finally called — reception goes to lunch 'back in eternity'.

episodes.title: Orientation Day
episodes.logline: Jesus runs Heaven's corporate onboarding; Lwazi just wants the Wi-Fi password.
episodes.synopsis: A mandatory onboarding where every question is 'parked', the icebreaker becomes a survival caper, and the entire exercise exists to withhold one thing: the Wi-Fi password.

skits.title: Please Hold All Questions
skits.setup: Mandatory onboarding; every question is 'a great question, let's park it'.
skits.action: Moses heckles from the back row.
skits.payoff: A harp is forced on Lwazi for mandatory recital.

skits.title: Icebreaker
skits.setup: 'Name, how you died, a fun fact.'
skits.action: Escalating one-upmanship across the international ensemble.

skits.title: The Password
skits.setup: The onboarding exists to withhold the Wi-Fi password.
skits.action: Jesus reveals the password is a parable.
skits.payoff: Button: it's 'Password123!' and Moses knew all along.

socialCuts.label: The Wi-Fi password is a parable
socialCuts.caption: Heaven's onboarding is just your worst job, forever.

episodes.title: The Complaints Department
episodes.logline: Moses has processed grievances for 4,000 years; one new complaint jams the system.
episodes.synopsis: Moses's intake ritual meets a complaint so modern it has no precedent. A caper to find where new grievances get filed ends with the oldest management trick: mark it 'Resolved' without resolving it.

skits.title: Four Thousand Years of Notes
skits.setup: Every complaint rhymes with every other, all in stone.
skits.action: Lwazi comes to complain about the E-1 and is told to take a (stone) tablet.
skits.payoff: A complaint with no precedent appears.

skits.title: Escalation
skits.setup: The new complaint breaks the filing logic.
skits.action: A caper through HR, past the Sultan, to a Bronze-Age storeroom of unopened suggestion boxes.

skits.title: Resolved
skits.setup: The fix is to mark it 'Resolved' without resolving it.
skits.action: Moses teaches Lwazi 'we've logged your feedback'.

socialCuts.label: We've logged your feedback
socialCuts.caption: Moses has heard your complaint. In stone. In 2000 BC.

episodes.title: Downstairs Neighbours
episodes.logline: A Heavenly Neighbours Potluck with the folks from Below hinges on one shared elevator.
episodes.synopsis: Heaven hosts a potluck to improve inter-departmental relations. Everyone brought the same dish, the Sultan 'visits' rather than queues, and the whole thing survives until Facilities sends a form.

skits.title: Mind the Gap
skits.setup: One elevator shared between Up and Down; strict etiquette.

skits.title: The Potluck
skits.action: A diplomatic caper over whose dish is canonical; Nigel trades snacks across the rope.
skits.payoff: Both sides equally absurd, equally dignified.

skits.title: Elevator's Out
skits.setup: The elevator jams with Up and Down inside together.
skits.action: They get along — until Brenda sends a form to report the incident.

socialCuts.label: Baklava at the potluck
socialCuts.caption: When Heaven and Hell share ONE elevator

episodes.title: Build a Brighter Eternity
episodes.logline: Management rolls out a 'transformation initiative'; the harps get an upgrade nobody asked for.
episodes.synopsis: A town-hall launches 'Eternity 2.0' with buzzwords as scripture and 'Harp Pro — now with a subscription'. A caper to keep the old harp alive ends in a quiet rollback to 'Eternity 2.0 (Classic)'.

skits.title: The Rollout
skits.setup: Town-hall announces Eternity 2.0; old harps decommissioned.

skits.title: Change Management
skits.setup: A compliance sweep for old harps.
skits.action: A caper to smuggle the beloved old harp past compliance.
skits.payoff: Everyone mouths support while quietly resisting.

skits.title: Rollback
skits.setup: The initiative collapses under its paperwork.
skits.payoff: Button: 'Thank you for your patience during our transformation journey.'

socialCuts.label: Harp Pro subscription
socialCuts.caption: Your harp now requires a monthly plan.

episodes.title: The Numbers
episodes.logline: The afterlife's quarterly stats don't add up, and someone has to answer to the Board.
episodes.synopsis: The destinations pie chart has a quietly growing 'Pending' slice. A back-office caper finds the missing souls stuck in The Queue; the fix is to rename 'Pending' to 'In Transition' and change the chart colour.

skits.title: Quarterly Review
skits.setup: The analyst presents the destinations pie chart.
skits.payoff: Nobody wants to mention it to God.

skits.title: The Discrepancy
skits.setup: A back-office hunt for the missing souls.
skits.action: They're all stuck in The Queue; the process was wrong, not the numbers.
skits.payoff: A race to reassign blame before the Board meeting.

skits.title: The Board Meeting
skits.setup: God asks one simple question nobody can answer.
skits.action: Rename 'Pending' to 'In Transition'; change the colour.
skits.payoff: Button: the largest slice is souls still filling in the E-1.

socialCuts.label: Rename Pending to In Transition
socialCuts.caption: The afterlife's stats don't add up and nobody will tell God.
